name: Super Pro Plus Stud Welder
description: Powerful 2,000-amp Stud Welder makes this Super Pro Plus Dent-Pulling System perfect for most any body repair job. 4 electrodes, for stud, Magna Wire, rivet welding, shrinking2 sizes of draw pins, for light- and heavy-gauge workIncludes twist-on/off slide hammer and "T" hand puller You'll use this professional system to repair most dents, "pull" creases, weld trim rivets, and shrink metal, and the robust 2,000-amp stud welder gun helps you get it done fast.
